title: Web: SceneShaderGLES3: Fragment shader compilation failed: wrong operand types (in highfp float and const int)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in Godot 4.7dev5

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev5 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9597) - AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 61.68 GiB memory

### Issue description

When I open my Game in the Web Browser (doesn't seem to matter which one), I get two similar errors in the dev console.
The whole shader code is also printed in the console.
I don't use any Shaders directly, so the errors must be from `GPUParticle2D` instances?

Error 1:

```
ERROR: SceneShaderGLES3: Fragment shader compilation failed:
index.js:467 ERROR: 0:1102: '>=' : wrong operand types - no operation '>=' exists that takes a left-hand operand of type 'in highp float' and a right operand of type 'const int' (or there is no acceptable conversion)
ERROR: 0:1358: '<=' : wrong operand types - no operation '<=' exists that takes a left-hand operand of type 'highp float' and a right operand of type 'const int' (or there is no acceptable conversion)
ERROR: 0:1390: 'max' : no matching overloaded function found
```

The shader lines in the console references by the stacktrace:

```
1102: 	return (p_x >= 0) ? res : M_PI - res;

1358: 	if (dot(area_direction, vertex - area_lights[idx].position) <= 0) {

1390: 	float light_length = max(0, dist);
```

Error 2:

```
ERROR: SceneShaderGLES3: Fragment shader compilation failed:
index.js:467 ERROR: 0:1103: '>=' : wrong operand types - no operation '>=' exists that takes a left-hand operand of type 'in highp float' and a right operand of type 'const int' (or there is no acceptable conversion)
ERROR: 0:1359: '<=' : wrong operand types - no operation '<=' exists that takes a left-hand operand of type 'highp float' and a right operand of type 'const int' (or there is no acceptable conversion)
ERROR: 0:1391: 'max' : no matching overloaded function found
```

The shader lines in the console references by the stacktrace:

```
1103: 	return (p_x >= 0) ? res : M_PI - res;

1359: 	if (dot(area_direction, vertex - area_lights[idx].position) <= 0) {

1391: 	float light_length = max(0, dist);
```

### Steps to reproduce

Open: https://maran23.itch.io/root-survivor
Open the Dev Console, click Play and see the errors.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See above, reproducable in Browser.
